_about: 예시 스토리보드(원작 캐릭터 · IP 없음). 에이전트가 이 꼴로 workspace/storyboard.json 을 쓴다. fixed = 편 전체 고정 블록, shots[].image/video = 가변 블록
title: copper-swordswoman-showcase

image.STYLE: Premium 3D anime game character render, cel-shaded toon shading, crisp rim light, AAA anime action RPG showcase quality.
image.CHARACTER: Same character as the attached reference: confident young swordswoman about 18, warm tan skin, short copper-red hair, bright amber eyes, cheeky grin.
image.OUTFIT: Outfit: cropped navy travel jacket with brass buttons, white shirt, dark utility shorts, knee-high brown boots, fingerless gloves.
image.BACKGROUND: Background: perfectly flat solid pure blue (#1E3CFF) studio backdrop, evenly lit, no gradient, no floor line, no shadows on the backdrop, the whole character clearly separated from the background with clean edges, for chroma keying.
image.TAIL: No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.

video.STYLE: 3D anime cel-shaded game character showcase style, energetic, snappy, stylish anime game motion with fluid follow-through.
video.KEEP: Keep the small brass compass badge on her jacket unchanged.

image.POSE: Close-up bust shot, looking slightly away, half-lidded eyes.

video.ACTION: She turns her gaze straight into the camera and breaks into a confident grin, a few hair strands drifting in a light breeze.

image.POSE: Full body, standing three-quarter view, one hand on the sword hilt, chin slightly raised.

video.ACTION: She spins once to face the camera, jacket hem swirling, draws the sword halfway and snaps it back into the sheath, ending with a hand on her hip.

image.POSE: Wide shot, she stands at the edge of a sunlit stone plaza with fluttering market banners.
image.BACKGROUND: Background: sunlit stone plaza with fluttering colorful market banners, soft morning light.

video.ACTION: Banners ripple in the wind as she walks toward the camera and stops with a playful salute.
